about: P1 R1 form library: HER BREASTS (OURS, designed; replacing the MakeHuman cup sliders bust_size / bust_firmness / bust_set / bust_point / bust_spacing and bust_lift, which a spec sets to 0 when it uses these). chest_wall is the base every designed breast sits on; breast_a (route a, a field set by profile curves, evaluated live) and breast_b (route b, a target sculpted once by tools/body/sculpt/breast_b.py) are the two candidate forms; support_lift / support_press / support_fill are the armor support fields (rule field: linear blend shapes an armor piece sets as data). Code: tools/body/breast_form.py.

chest_wall.why: the base: the MakeHuman base mesh carries a small mound and a nipple (8.8 mm tip over its smoothed chest) that every designed breast would carry on its apex; the region is refilled as a smooth chest wall (biharmonic fill, rim held, a C2 blend), so the breast sliders over it are pure added volumes, clean at any value. P1 R1c (milestone judge: a lit lip along both upper poles, a V across the upper chest): the region carried up to the collarbone hollow (V0 centre y 1.428 -> 1.452, radii 85 x 105 -> 92 x 129 mm, bottom kept): its old top rim sat where the breast's upper pole meets the wall, and the rim's convex turn between the clavicle hollow and the breast's root fold read as a lip (curvature on the apex path concave -> +7/m -> concave -> convex); now the slope from the collarbone is one concave-to-convex turn

breast_a.why: ROUTE (a): the breast as a height field over the chest wall along its axis, set by profile curves (see breast_form.dome). P1 R1b: the lower pole is the ROUND law (an arc of R_m 90 mm from the apex into a soft fold the law solves to fit h_m over r.low; measured on the body ~127 mm, the wall's slope shears it), its move turned down with the receding wall (pitch_low_deg), the cap keeps each pole's own curvature (cap axes: the upper pole's soft s 0.8 cap, so the apex reads round, not a cone point); relax evens the medial column the midline fade stretches (V0 mask off the midline: the cleavage floor untouched). R1b round 2 (judge fix 2-3): the outer side at armpit height comes in 12-18 mm (r.lat_up: the upper outer quadrant's own lateral radius 92 mm above w0, the hanging arm meets a clean gap); the axis turned forward (yaw 14 -> 10, fan 120 -> 100) and the volume put forward and in (h_m 0.104, r.med 0.09; apex 7 mm in, 5 mm forward); the base point 3 mm lower and the move pitched up 1 deg (the apex normal is the chest wall's at the base: there it faces level, pitch 3.6 -> 1.5, apex height kept); r.low 0.15 keeps the fold soft. R1b round 3 (judge fix 1): lat_up is switched by the direction from the apex (psi_deg -20..60, 0 lateral, 90 up), not by height: round 2's height switch squeezed every ray that crossed it, a concave band between the apex and the armpit (a cloud on the cel terminator, a pleat at the outer edge); by direction each ray keeps the profile's own shape and every contour stays convex, the edge at armpit height still 7-11 mm in (the clavicle weights do the rest: weights_topo v4); h_m 0.104 -> 0.1035 keeps the volume in band (the wider upper outer quadrant gave +21 mL). P1 R1c (milestone judge: the cleavage opened into a V notch at its top; a lit lip along both upper poles): r.med_up (the upper INNER quadrant's own medial radius 0.125 by direction, psi 0..55 deg, eased in from the apex over half the radius: the inner walls stay full higher, the cleavage line starts ~3 cm higher); the axis yaw 10 -> 7 (the breasts turned in: apex 3 mm in by formrules, 8 mm on the hanging body, the inner flanks pressed toward the midline; moving the base point instead tipped the apex normal up 5 deg: the apex normal is the wall's at the base); midline_fade 0.025 -> 0.032 and the medial relax taller (to V0 y 1.555, 35 steps): the pressed inner column's quads stay under aspect 4 with no fold on the cleavage floor; h_m 0.1035 -> 0.1008 keeps the volume in band (med_up and the taller relax gave +45 mL)

breast_b.why: ROUTE (b): the breast sculpted once: a round-cone solid (a big sphere for the round lower pole and the apex cap, a small one up and back inside the chest, the cone between them the upper pole) smoothly unioned with the chest wall, the region carried onto it and relaxed (see the generator)

support_lift.why: ARMOR SUPPORT, the lift (an underwire, a corset top, a plate cup): the breast carried up 16 mm at v = 1, full under the apex and easing out over the upper pole (so the upper pole gathers and fills) and over the rim (the fold rises with it); linear (a blend shape the armor piece sets)

support_press.why: ARMOR SUPPORT, the press (the side padding of a plunge cup): the breast pushed 14 mm toward the midline and 4 mm forward at v = 1, easing to 0 at the midline (the sternum holds; the inner side gathers: a deeper cleavage, the gradient 0.47 so nothing crosses); linear

support_fill.why: ARMOR SUPPORT, the fill (the mass a cup displaces rising over its edge): the upper pole 9 mm forward and 3 mm up at v = 1, a smooth bell over the upper pole between the apex and the root (round and full above a cup edge); negative values flatten it (a wrap); linear
